_approach: The plainest reading of the genre name: kicks on beats 1, 2 and 4, beat 3 left completely silent on the kick and filled instead by a tomLow+congaLow 'log drum' answer borrowed from Amapiano (the article's 'deep basslines and log drums from Amapiano'). Shaker is the timekeeper throughout; claps sit on 2 and 4 under the kick. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
